LanguageData.TM_ManaGene.label: mana
LanguageData.TM_StaminaGene.label: stamina
LanguageData.TM_ManaGene.description: A classless carrier gains magical potential and can learn a magic class. For a pawn who already has a class, this gene marks their magic and does not grant another class or potential. Children of carriers may be born with the hidden mage gene.
LanguageData.TM_StaminaGene.description: A classless carrier gains physical potential and can learn a warrior class. For a pawn who already has a class, this gene marks their might and does not grant another class or potential. Children of carriers may be born with the sleeping warrior gene.
